theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.evalStep_congr : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (index : ℕ) (values other : ℕ → Option NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val), (∀ operand ∈ (graph.node index).operands, values operand = other operand) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.evalStep graph values inputs index = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.evalStep graph other inputs index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.valuesUpTo_succ
theorems.claim: The value of the first `count + 1` nodes, at `count`.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.valuesUpTo_succ : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (count index : ℕ), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.valuesUpTo graph inputs (count + 1) index = if index = count then NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.evalStep graph (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.valuesUpTo graph inputs count) inputs count else NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.valuesUpTo graph inputs count index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.valuesUpTo_stable
theorems.claim: An earlier node's value does not change once the value list has reached a later index.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.valuesUpTo_stable : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (bound index : ℕ), index < bound → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.valuesUpTo graph inputs bound index = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.valuesUpTo graph inputs (index + 1) index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.value_eq_bodyValue
theorems.claim: **The `define-fun` fixed point.** A node's value is its emitted body evaluated with the values of the earlier nodes — which is exactly how a query's bodies are read, one symbol per node.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.value_eq_bodyValue : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (index : ℕ), (∀ operand ∈ (graph.node index).operands, operand < index) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index = NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.bodyValue (fun j => NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs j) inputs (graph.node index)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.bodyValue_simulates
theorems.claim: **The encoded node bodies simulate the graph, node by node, for every input.**
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.bodyValue_simulates : ∀ (nodes : List NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node) (out : ℕ) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (index : ℕ), (∀ operand ∈ (nodes.getD index (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)).operands, operand < index) → NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.bodyValue (fun j => NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value (NobleFoundation.FirstProjection.ofList nodes out) inputs j) inputs (nodes.getD index (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value (NobleFoundation.FirstProjection.ofList nodes out) inputs index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.any_congruence
theorems.claim: `List.any` respects a pointwise equality.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.any_congruence : ∀ (list : List ℕ) (first second : ℕ → Bool), (∀ value ∈ list, first value = second value) → list.any first = list.any second

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.claimAt_simulates
theorems.claim: One compared output of the query is one compared output of the model.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.claimAt_simulates : ∀ (subject : NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.Subject) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (out : ℕ), (∀ operand ∈ (subject.left.getD out (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)).operands, operand < out) → (∀ operand ∈ (subject.right.getD out (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)).operands, operand < out) → NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.claimAt subject inputs out = decide (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value (NobleFoundation.FirstProjection.ofList subject.left 0) inputs out ≠ NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value (NobleFoundation.FirstProjection.ofList subject.right 0) inputs out)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.EarlierWithin.mp
theorems.claim: A checked `EarlierWithin` is the operand-order premise of `claim_simulates`.
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.EarlierWithin.mp : ∀ {nodes : List NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node}, NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.EarlierWithin nodes = true → ∀ index < nodes.length, ∀ operand ∈ (nodes.getD index (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)).operands, operand < index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.OutputsWithin.mp
theorems.claim: A checked `OutputsWithin` is the output-range premise of `claim_simulates`.
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.OutputsWithin.mp : ∀ {subject : NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.Subject}, NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.OutputsWithin subject = true → ∀ out ∈ subject.outputs, out < subject.left.length ∧ out < subject.right.length

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.claim_simulates
theorems.claim: **The query's assertion is the refutation predicate, for every 64-bit input.** For a subject inside the admitted fragment — every operand an earlier node on both sides, every listed output a node of both graphs — the claim the encoded assertion makes, read through the emitted bodies, is exactly `refuted` of the model pair the subject denotes.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.claim_simulates : ∀ (subject : NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.Subject) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), (∀ index < subject.left.length, ∀ operand ∈ (subject.left.getD index (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)).operands, operand < index) → (∀ index < subject.right.length, ∀ operand ∈ (subject.right.getD index (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant 0)).operands, operand < index) → (∀ out ∈ subject.outputs, out < subject.left.length ∧ out < subject.right.length) → NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.claimValue subject inputs = NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted (NobleFoundation.SymbolicEncoder.subjectPair subject) inputs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.refused_is_unsupported
theorems.claim: A refused row is `unsupported`, whatever else it carries: refusal precedes every other check.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.refused_is_unsupported : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = false → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.stale_binding_inconclusive
theorems.claim: A stale or altered binding is `inconclusive` whatever certificate or answer it carries.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.stale_binding_inconclusive : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = false → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_certifies
theorems.claim: A bound kernel certificate certifies, whatever the solver answered and whichever model it returned: the certificate's subject is the graphs, not the answer.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_certifies : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = true → observed.certificate = true → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unfinished_inconclusive
theorems.claim: An answer other than `sat` is never a counterexample: without a certificate it stays `inconclusive`, whether it is UNSAT, UNKNOWN, a timeout, an error or a row that never ran.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unfinished_inconclusive : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = true → observed.certificate = false → observed.answer ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.rejected_model_inconclusive
theorems.claim: A model that did not parse is never a counterexample.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.rejected_model_inconclusive : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = true → observed.certificate = false → observed.answer = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat → observed.modelParsed = false → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.agreeing_model_inconclusive
theorems.claim: A model that parses but agrees on the original graphs is never a counterexample.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.agreeing_model_inconclusive : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = true → observed.certificate = false → observed.answer = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat → observed.modelParsed = true → observed.modelReplays = false → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.replaying_model_refutes
theorems.claim: A parsed model that replays on the original graphs is a counterexample.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.replaying_model_refutes : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = true → observed.certificate = false → observed.answer = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat → observed.modelParsed = true → observed.modelReplays = true → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.not_refused_not_unsupported
theorems.claim: A row that was not refused is never `unsupported`.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.not_refused_not_unsupported : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unsupported_iff_refused
theorems.claim: `unsupported` is exactly a refused row.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unsupported_iff_refused : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported ↔ observed.withinBudget = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_absent_not_certified
theorems.claim: Without a certificate a row never certifies.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_absent_not_certified : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), observed.withinBudget = true → observed.bound = true → observed.certificate = false → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certified_requires_certificate
theorems.claim: `certified` requires a certificate: nothing else in a row can produce that status.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certified_requires_certificate : ∀ (observed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Observation), NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify observed = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified → observed.certificate = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_certificate
theorems.claim: A claim with a bound certificate is certified whatever its rows say.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_certificate : ∀ (runs : List NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict), NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus true runs = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_refutes
theorems.claim: A claim with a refuted row is refuted.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_refutes : ∀ (runs : List NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict), runs.contains NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted = true → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus false runs = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_inconclusive
theorems.claim: A claim with neither a certificate nor a refuted row is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_inconclusive : ∀ (runs : List NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict), runs.contains NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted = false → NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus false runs = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.refused_fixture
theorems.claim: A refused row is unsupported.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.refused_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := false, bound := false, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.notRun } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.stale_binding_fixture
theorems.claim: A stale binding with a certificate is inconclusive: the binding is checked first.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.stale_binding_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := false, certificate := true, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unsat } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_with_unknown_fixture
theorems.claim: A certificate with an UNKNOWN answer is certified: the certificate is checked before the answer.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_with_unknown_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := true, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unknown } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_with_replayed_model_fixture
theorems.claim: A certificate with a sat answer and a replaying model is still certified at row level; the claim-level refusal of that contradiction is the lane's assertion, not this row rule.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.certificate_with_replayed_model_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := true, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := true, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unsat_fixture
theorems.claim: External UNSAT without a certificate is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unsat_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unsat } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.rejected_model_fixture
theorems.claim: A sat answer whose model did not parse is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.rejected_model_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.agreeing_model_fixture
theorems.claim: A sat answer whose model agrees is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.agreeing_model_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.replayed_model_fixture
theorems.claim: A sat answer whose model replays is refuted.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.replayed_model_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := true, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unknown_fixture
theorems.claim: UNKNOWN is inconclusive, a different status from refusal.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.unknown_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unknown } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.timeout_fixture
theorems.claim: A watchdog timeout is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.timeout_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.timeout } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.error_fixture
theorems.claim: A solver error is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.error_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.error } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.refused_with_certificate_fixture
theorems.claim: A refused claim row with a certificate the caller supplied is still unsupported.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.refused_with_certificate_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := false, bound := true, certificate := true, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.notRun } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_certificate_fixture
theorems.claim: A certified claim is certified even when its only row is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_certificate_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus true [NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive] = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_refuted_fixture
theorems.claim: A claim with a refuted row is refuted.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_refuted_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus false [NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive, NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted] = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_inconclusive_fixture
theorems.claim: A claim with neither is inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claim_inconclusive_fixture : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus false [NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive] = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_binding_first_differs
theorems.claim: The retired model's order differs on a refused row whose binding is also stale.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_binding_first_differs : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyBindingFirst { withinBudget := false, bound := false, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.notRun } ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := false, bound := false, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.notRun }

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_binding_first_refusal
theorems.claim: Checking the binding first would also hide a refusal behind a stale binding.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_binding_first_refusal : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyBindingFirst { withinBudget := false, bound := false, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.notRun } = NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_answer_first_differs
theorems.claim: Certifying after the answer changes a certified pair whose model also replayed.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_answer_first_differs : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyAnswerFirst { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := true, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := true, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := true, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := true, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat }

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_encoding_checked_differs
theorems.claim: Feeding the encoder verdict into the status changes a corrupted query whose model replayed.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_encoding_checked_differs : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyEncodingChecked { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := true, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } false ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := true, modelReplays := true, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat }

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_sat_refutes_differs
theorems.claim: Reporting a sat answer as a counterexample changes an unparsed model.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_sat_refutes_differs : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifySatRefutes { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat } ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.sat }

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_unsat_certifies_differs
theorems.claim: Accepting external UNSAT as agreement changes an inconclusive row.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.mutation_unsat_certifies_differs : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyUnsatCertifies { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unsat } ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unsat }

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receipt_rows_decide
theorems.claim: The kernel decides that classify reproduces every solver and endpoint receipt row from its recorded observation tuple.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receipt_rows_decide : (NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receiptRows.all fun row => NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify row.observation == row.status) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.certified_rows_decide
theorems.claim: Every receipt row recorded as certified is classified certified.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.certified_rows_decide : ((List.filter (fun row => row.status == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified) NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receiptRows).all fun row => NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify row.observation == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.refuted_rows_decide
theorems.claim: Every receipt row recorded as refuted is classified refuted.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.refuted_rows_decide : ((List.filter (fun row => row.status == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted) NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receiptRows).all fun row => NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify row.observation == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.refuted) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.inconclusive_rows_decide
theorems.claim: Every receipt row recorded as inconclusive is classified inconclusive.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.inconclusive_rows_decide : ((List.filter (fun row => row.status == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive) NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receiptRows).all fun row => NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify row.observation == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.inconclusive) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.unsupported_rows_decide
theorems.claim: Every receipt row recorded as unsupported is classified unsupported.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.unsupported_rows_decide : ((List.filter (fun row => row.status == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported) NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receiptRows).all fun row => NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classify row.observation == NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.claims_decide
theorems.claim: The kernel decides the aggregate status of every recorded claim from its certificate and row statuses.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.claims_decide : (NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.receiptClaims.all fun claim => NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.claimStatus claim.certificate claim.runs == claim.status) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.mutation_binding_first_killed
theorems.claim: The binding-before-refusal mutation changes the recorded node-budget refusal.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.mutation_binding_first_killed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyBindingFirst { withinBudget := false, bound := false, certificate := false, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.notRun } ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.unsupported

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.mutation_answer_first_killed
theorems.claim: The answer-before-certificate mutation changes a recorded bound certificate row.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.mutation_answer_first_killed : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.classifyAnswerFirst { withinBudget := true, bound := true, certificate := true, modelParsed := false, modelReplays := false, answer := NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Answer.unsat } ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.Verdict.certified

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.RefusalsReplay.mutation_encoding_checked_killed
theorems.claim: Using the encoder check as a status input changes a recorded corrupted-query row whose model replays.
